summary: Complete hold-routing proof with isolated fixtures
validation_scope: Authorized existing isolated fixtures with installed router and fake HOLD_DOMAIN_HERDR transport.
testing_summary: Deferred and reserved fixtures passed sequentially; unchanged original-hold, scheduling, blocked-row and receipt-recovery results reused at the same target. No product or test edits required.

scenarios.name: Expired update-branch and EP-approved capacity holds release to their declared owners once per lifecycle.
scenarios.reason: Reused unchanged target evidence: real hold CLI and installed router, fake transport; matching owner receipts and one prompt per lifecycle.

scenarios.name: Money, credentials, people, client words, production, accounts, taste, mixed asks, and declared human owners remain held.
scenarios.reason: Existing reserved fixture rerun with installed router and fake transport; all eleven reserved/human holds remain held with no owner prompt or routing receipt.

scenarios.name: Changing a technical hold into a production question prevents stale routing fields from releasing it.
scenarios.reason: Existing fixture observes reason-drift refusal and a held production question; replacing the stale routing metadata retires technical pending work.

scenarios.name: Creating or postponing a deferred hold preserves its pending routing record through a sweep before its date.
scenarios.reason: Fresh and postponed cases both pass through public hold and watcher interfaces; supervision stays required, pending bodies survive, and pre-date prompt and receipt counts are zero.

scenarios.name: When a deferral expires, the watcher transfers responsibility once and releases the hold without completing the task.
scenarios.reason: Both cases route to ep-firstmate at the date, release into queued state, persist one receipt without captain words, converge on replay, and retire supervision.

scenarios.name: Repeated bounded sweeps reach later and newly added holds despite blocked locks, writes, and unholds, while preserving ordinary checks and cleanup.
scenarios.reason: Reused failing-before and passing-target isolated evidence: interrupted repeated sweeps, row insertion/retirement, all three blocking sites, scheduled checks and subprocess cleanup.

scenarios.name: Failed delivery preserves the hold, and an interrupted release recovers from its receipt without prompting twice.
scenarios.reason: Reused unchanged passing isolated target evidence; pending work survives failure and recovery consumes the single existing receipt.

limitations: Isolated transport does not prove delivery to an active live harness; no real Herdr sessions were touched in this correction.
Real endpoint cutover and next-day validation remain Firstmate-owned after landing, outside this worker phase.
Historical default-session read-only tripwire checks via local socket link are documented only from saved evidence; no default panes were driven according to that record.
Accepted base-only approved-merge fixture limitation and existing Firstmate CI hold are preserved; no workflow changes or full-suite/CI-green claim.

artifacts.label: Scoped proof procedure and historical boundaries
